layout.postureText: Identity, governance, evidence and runtime protection are presented as one control plane.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.consoleTitle: A single control plane for LLM security, governance and audit evidence.
dashboard.consoleSubtitle: ShadowAI now presents itself as what the backend already is: an enterprise security console for controlled LLM adoption.

protect.title: Runtime LLM Firewall
protect.body: Streaming inspection, sanitize/block outcomes, semantic shadow rollout and audit-ready policy decisions.

govern.title: Provider and budget control
govern.body: Per-org allowlists, role/context scoped routing, department sensitivity and aggregate org budget caps.
govern.signal: Policy cache and org isolation enabled

evidence.title: Tamper-evident audit chain
evidence.body: HMAC chain, Merkle anchors, Ed25519 manifests, Object Lock bundles and offline auditor verification.

operate.title: Identity and production controls
operate.body: OIDC, SCIM, admin MFA, break-glass, production validation and evidence collection runbooks.

dashboard.trafficSubtitle: Existing dashboard data, now framed as control-plane signal
dashboard.maskedIdentityNote: PII-minimized: masked email + stable user id

signals.blockRateDetail: Derived from total and blocked request counters.
signals.siemDetail: Async batching, retry and backpressure controls are implemented.
signals.streamingDetail: Incremental mode remains gated by proof-window criteria.

evidence.title: Chain-of-custody evidence for auditors and operators.
evidence.subtitle: This view shows how ShadowAI turns audit rows into verifiable evidence bundles: HMAC chain, Merkle anchors, signed manifests, independent sinks and Object Lock retention.

db.label: DB tamper detection
db.detail: Gaps or row rewrites are detected by the verifier through seq_no and HMAC continuity.

external.label: External witness
external.detail: Anchors are signed and published to file/immudb/additional sinks for an independent witness layer.

bundle.label: Portable auditor bundle
bundle.detail: Global and tenant bundles verify offline without live DB access; tenant bundles do not expose cross-tenant row hashes.

chain.title: Hash chain on audit tables
chain.body: All critical audit tables receive seq_no and row_hash; verifier catches gaps and chain breaks.

anchors.title: Signed Merkle anchors
anchors.body: The scheduler builds Merkle roots over row_hash ranges and signs manifests with an Ed25519 key id.

sinks.title: Independent witness sinks
sinks.body: Primary sink keeps backward compatibility; W8 additional sinks surface degraded posture on partial failure.

objectLock.title: S3 Object Lock retention
objectLock.body: Evidence export uploads only verified bundles; Object Lock mode/retention/hold are checked by the report CLI.

bundle.title: Offline evidence bundle
bundle.body: Bundle contains manifest hashes, anchors, chain inventory or tenant Merkle proofs and public key.

validation.title: Production go/no-go validation
validation.body: PROD1 ties live rollout, readiness, bundle verification and retention posture into one report.

evidence.pipelineTitle: From audit row to portable bundle
evidence.pipelineNote: This diagram shows the capability contract. Operators run the commands below and archive output for live evidence.

rows.title: Audit rows
rows.body: Proxy, admin, legal hold and purge events are written into scoped tables.

chain.title: HMAC continuity
chain.body: Row hash links the current canonical row with the previous tip.

merkle.title: Merkle range
merkle.body: Anchor root covers a contiguous seq_no range.

sign.title: Signed manifest
sign.body: Ed25519 signature covers sink_ref and anchor fields.

sink.title: Witness sinks
sink.body: file/immudb/additional sinks receive one signed manifest.

bundle.title: Auditor bundle
bundle.body: Offline verifier checks signatures, hashes, ranges and proofs.

evidence.commandsTitle: Checks that produce real evidence artifacts
evidence.operatorTitle: What the UI must not overpromise

notLive.title: This is not live monitoring
notLive.body: UX2 shows the implemented control model. Actual status comes from CLI reports, CronJob status and Prometheus alerts.

independentSink.title: Second sink is configuration-dependent
independentSink.body: W8 supports additional sinks, but regulated deployments must explicitly configure an independent witness.

restoreDrill.title: Restore drill remains operator-owned
restoreDrill.body: The command is automated, but scheduling, execution and evidence retention remain an operational control.
